candidates.name: Correct a boundary mistake on a title plan
verified_facts: HM Land Registry provides a process for asking that a title-plan boundary mistake be corrected and requires information supporting the claimed correction.
A correction changes the registered plan only through the evidence and registration process.
semantic_limits: A correction workflow does not itself certify centimetre-level geometry or provide terrain elevation and vertical-accuracy evidence.

candidates.name: Finding information held by HM Land Registry
verified_facts: The guidance explains routes for finding registers, title plans, deeds and other information held by HM Land Registry.
Different document types have different evidential roles and availability.
semantic_limits: Document discovery and availability metadata do not constitute direct parcel geometry or elevation observations.
